verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for an AI workspace product, so the axis applies. The pack documents no first-party export of chats, workspaces or documents in open formats. Local and self-hosted operation and a developer API for 'programmatic reading' are adjacent building blocks, not a documented export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
